title: Stop Using Your Engine Brake Like This (Part 2)
hook: Part two! Select your gear early.

script.narration: Part two! Select your gear early.
script.visual_search: driver shifting manual gear stick down on highway

script.narration: Which gear should you choose before heading down a steep mountain pass?
script.visual_search: POV winding mountain road from car windshield

script.narration: Pause if you need to guess. The answer is the exact same lower gear you would use to drive back up that hill.
script.visual_search: dashboard showing low gear indicator on car

script.narration: Doing this protects your brake pads from overheating and fading completely.
script.visual_search: close up of car brake disc glowing hot on track

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this? Comment yes or no, because part two! Select your gear early.
script.visual_search: car driving safely down scenic mountain road

description:
Welcome to Part 2 of Engine Brake Mastery. Building on our previous guide, learn how to properly select the correct lower gear before descending a steep mountain pass to protect your brakes.

Essential driving knowledge for every vehicle owner to prevent brake fade on long descents.
